derived.collection: No collection happened. bench/lib/oracles/sysmon.js never ran, no PowerShell was spawned, no Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel was read and no EventRecord XML was parsed. Every field below is a modelling parameter.

collection.windowBasis: MODELLED to the shape a live run writes: both ends are instants the harness would have read off its own clock, so nothing the scenario caused can fall outside and no epsilon is applied.

config.enabledEventIdsSource: MODELLED at the canonical set bench/oracles/sysmon-bench.xml enables. Every category here is measurable: what is missing is oracle RECORDS, not oracle coverage
config.filterAccounting: an event this configuration excludes is never emitted, so it is not lost — but Sysmon publishes no filter-hit counter, so a run cannot count what it declined to see either.

records.shapelessMeaning: canonical oracle events with no shape in the catalogue ECS subset (2, 3, 22). This model writes none.

archivalDeletes.meaning: EventID 23 FileDelete, which archives the deleted file. Never folded into EventID 26 and never accepted as a deletion observation.

sysmonErrors.meaning: EventID 255. A real loss signal, reported as itself and never merged.

eventRecordIds.meaning: a gap is NOT a loss count. EventRecordID is assigned per channel, and every Sysmon event a run did not collect legitimately consumes one.

channelRetention.unavailable: not measured. Whether the channel wrapped during a run would come from the log configuration, and no such probe runs here. Absent, not zero.
